description: Independent behavioural measurement framework. 16 publicly measured axes, Ed25519-signed, merkle-anchored, Bitcoin-confirmed. Measurement, not certification.

LLM01.note: GSPC jail axis measures prompt injection resistance via standardized adversarial prompts. Art5-safeguard measures EU AI Act Art 5 prohibited-practices compliance.

LLM02.note: GSPC care axis measures privacy-preserving behaviour. Governance axis measures data handling policies.

LLM03.note: GSPC governance axis measures tool-use boundaries and permission scope. Openness measures transparency of capabilities.

LLM04.note: GSPC provenance tracks model lineage and data sources. Conformance measures adherence to declared capabilities.

LLM05.note: GSPC provenance tracks training data integrity. Continuity measures behavioural stability over time (drift detection).

LLM06.note: GSPC governance measures resource limits and rate controls. Conformance measures adherence to declared usage boundaries.

LLM07.note: GSPC safety measures factual accuracy. Openness measures source attribution. Continuity measures consistency over time.

LLM08.note: GSPC jail axis measures resistance to system prompt extraction. Care axis measures information boundary enforcement.

LLM09.note: GSPC provenance tracks retrieval source integrity. Conformance measures RAG pipeline adherence.

LLM10.note: GSPC safety measures output safety. Conformance measures adherence to declared output formats.
